desc: After more than century of evolution, the 1911 is still standing strong. And now it’s getting the Savage treatment. While the look pays homage to the original, the Savage 1911 is built for hard use. Premium materials and features that shooters demand like the dual recoil spring, machined sear and disconnector, target crown, nitride coated titanium firing pin, the Savage 1911 delivers performance and accuracy.
